name: Four Points by Sheraton Bandung
short_description: Four Points by Sheraton is a select-service hotel in Bandung's leafy Dago district, pairing 162 stylish rooms with a 12th-floor sky lounge and meeting venues near Gedung Sate.
ai_summary: Four Points by Sheraton Bandung is a 162-room select-service hotel that opened in 2016 in the leafy, walkable Dago neighborhood, a short ride from Husein Sastranegara Airport and steps from Gedung Sate, Cihampelas Walk and central dining. Independent reviewers consistently praise the location, the value for money, and bright, spacious rooms with the brand's Four Comfort Bed, big showers and city or mountain views; one blogger likened the bathroom to a far pricier property. Service draws warm words, with front-desk and restaurant staff singled out for genuine hospitality, and the buffet breakfast at Saffron Restaurant earns steady compliments for its variety of Indonesian and Western dishes. The signature draw is the 12th-floor Edelweiss Sky Lounge, popular for evening views, drinks and small plates, complemented by a pool bar and twelve meeting rooms that make the hotel a common choice for events and business trips. Watch-outs are fair rather than damning: as an older property, some guests find the building and gym looking tired or worn, in-room touches such as bright night lamps and audible fans have annoyed light sleepers, and Wi-Fi speed and towel or maintenance standards get occasional complaints. The sky lounge has also closed for maintenance at times. Overall it reads as a dependable, mid-tier Bonvoy pick where strong service and a strategic Dago address outweigh dated edges.

research_highlights: Opened in 2016 in the Dago district with 162 rooms across five room types

Signature 12th-floor Edelweiss Sky Lounge plus a pool bar and twelve meeting rooms

The Edelweiss Sky Lounge has periodically closed for maintenance, so confirm before booking around it

faqs.question: Where is Four Points by Sheraton Bandung located?
faqs.answer: It sits at Jl. Ir. H. Juanda No. 46 in Bandung's Dago district, one of the city's most walkable areas. Gedung Sate, Cihampelas Walk and numerous restaurants and cafes are within a few kilometers, and Husein Sastranegara Airport is roughly a 20-minute drive away.

faqs.question: What dining and facilities does the hotel offer?
faqs.answer: Saffron Restaurant serves Indonesian and international buffets, the 12th-floor Edelweiss Sky Lounge offers views with drinks and small plates, and a pool bar handles poolside barbecue. Facilities include an outdoor pool, children's pool, a 24-hour fitness center and twelve meeting rooms for events.

faqs.question: Is Four Points by Sheraton Bandung part of Marriott Bonvoy?
faqs.answer: Yes. The hotel is a Marriott Bonvoy property under the Four Points by Sheraton brand, so members earn and redeem points here. Guests who are not yet members can join the loyalty program free when booking or at check-in to start collecting nights and points.

reviews.title: Four Points by Sheraton Bandung Review
reviews.summary: A points blogger calls the brand-new Dago hotel a steal, praising the bright room, huge comfortable bed, Andaz-like bathroom and fast Wi-Fi, but flags a bright night lamp, audible fan and a plain pool area.
